messages.subject: ggplot2 performance on r 2.14
parts:
Did anyone try ggplot2 on early builds of the new R 2.14? What are the
experiences with regard to performance? Can we expect some noticeable
speedup from the byte compiler?

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 performance on r 2.14
parts:
Hi Jeroen,

I never thought to benchmark it, but I do a lot of day-to-day work in
R-devel (so I've been using the byte compiled version for awhile now),
and I did not notice any particular performance enhancements. It's
not difficult to benchmark if you want empirical evidence. I know
there are big changes in the works for ggplot2 and my hunch is that
those would make a bigger difference than a change in R core.

Cheers,

Josh
